Name: Better Return Scepter
Author: DecidedlyHuman
Description:
Code:
[img]https://img.shields.io/github/license/AlanDavison/StardewValleyMods[/img]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/79440738-1763029182.png[/img]
Ever wished the return sceptre would let you warp back to where you were when you used it last? Well, now it does. Works perfectly with controllers, with a default controller keybind of left stick.

[b]Note: Currently incompatible with Android.[/b]

Short walkthrough video:
[youtube]gNu_st2aKqA[/youtube]

[b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/79440738-1763028878.png[/img][/b]
Newest features: Integration with PeacefulEnd's Multiple Mini-Obelisks mod. Now you can use the scepter to open the warp menu.

1.1.0 — Added integration with PeacefulEnd's Multiple Mini-Obelisks mod. Now you can use the scepter to open the warp menu.
1.0.0 — The mod exists!

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/79440738-1772986524.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Enable Multiple Mini-Obelisk support if installed: [b]false[/b][/*]
[*]Count using the Multiple Mini-Obelisks warp menu through the scepter as scepter usage: [b]false[/b][/*]
[*]Return to previous location (with scepter held): [b]Left stick (L3 Playstation-style)[/b][/*]
[*]Open Multiple Mini-Obelisks mod warp menu: [b]tilde (OemTilde)[/b][/*]
[*]Open Multiple Mini-Obelisks mod warp menu (controller): [b]BigButton (Xbox/PS button)[/b][/*]
[/list]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/79440738-1763029247.png[/img]
There's a known incompatibility with the Multiple Mini-Obelisks support/integration when you have the Better Hay mod installed. I [i]believe [/i]the problem to be with the Better Hay mod, but I can't be 100% certain until I dive deeper into it.

Either way, if you have Better Hay installed, you won't be able to open up Multiple Mini-Obelisks's warp menu using the return scepter.

* Minor reliability tweak. Now things will keep working if someone renames the Return Scepter for some reason.
